_comment: Headless gateway (backend/gateway/). Shared defaults only — personal settings (and later the IRC server/nick) go in the overlay file outside the repo, see README.md.
_trust_comment: What each trust level's turns may use. A missing key is false. web_search sends the query to DuckDuckGo, the one thing that leaves this machine, so only the owner has it by default. Destructive/publish tool calls additionally need an owner turn AND an owner approver, whatever this says.
_file_memory_comment: MEMORY.md + daily/YYYY-MM-DD.md (backend/gateway/file_memory.py). dir null = <data dir>/memory, outside the repo. Read on turns with the memories grant, written on turns with memory_writes, for the personas listed.
_irc_comment: IRC adapter (backend/gateway/irc.py), daemon only. Put host, network, nick, channels, owner_accounts and any passwords in the overlay (<data dir>/gateway.json), never here. See docs/gateway.md.
